先选场景，再选人工或辅助接近，按开始。辅助接近在 30 m 与 5 m 停靠点减: Choose a scenario, select manual or assisted approach, then start. Assisted approach slows and stabilises at the 30 m and 5 m hold points. Press GO when checks are ready. Any manual thrust takes control.
暂停会冻结时间；保持位置会消耗推力抑制漂移；撤离会沿接口外侧退开。松开平移键仍有: Pause freezes time. Position hold uses thrust to counter drift. Retreat moves outward from the port. Translation keeps drifting after key release; hold Space for relative braking.
开启角速率阻尼时，松开姿态键会逐渐停止转动；关闭后保留角速率。相机固定在机体上，: With rate damping enabled, releasing attitude keys gradually stops rotation; with it disabled, angular rate persists. The camera is body-fixed. The gold box is only an aid marking the known target position.
无推力预测：未来 60 秒 HCW 自由漂移，不含后续控制、碰撞或捕获。蓝色细线: Coast prediction: 60 s of unforced HCW motion, without future control, collision or capture. The thin blue line shows the flown trajectory.
400 km 圆参考轨道的 HCW 相对运动、四元数姿态与受限角速率控制。使用理: HCW relative motion about a circular 400 km reference orbit, quaternion attitude and bounded angular-rate control. Navigation is ideal and port contact is simplified; sensors, contact mechanisms and full rigid-body dynamics are not modelled. Limits are training settings, not Shenzhou flight parameters.
